scenarios.titleVi: Đón Customer, Đặt bàn & Chọn chỗ ngồi
scenarios.situation: Tình huống tại nhà hàng: Đón Customer, Đặt bàn & Chọn chỗ ngồi
scenarios.initialMessageEn: Hi, how may I help you? How many people are you guys?
scenarios.initialMessageVi: Chào mừng quý khách! Tôi có thể giúp gì cho bạn hôm nay?

vocabulary.exampleEn: Do you have a reservation with us?
vocabulary.exampleVi: Quý khách có đặt bàn trước với chúng tôi không?

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Hi, how may I help you? How many people are you guys?

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Hi, a table for two, please. Do you have a table available right now?

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Did you have a reservation with us?

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Yes, I have a reservation for two at 7 PM under the name John.

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Let me check that for you right away. Yes, Mr. John, your table is all set! Right this way, please.

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Could we get a table by the window, please? We'd prefer a quiet table if possible.

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Let me check if that table is reserved; if not, you're welcome to move. Yes, it's free! Right here.

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: This table is great, thank you. And non-smoking area, please.

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: All of our indoor seating is non-smoking. Here are your menus. I'll give you a few minutes to look them over.

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: This is perfect, thank you.

scenarios.situation: Tình huống tại nhà hàng: Hỏi gợi ý thực đơn
scenarios.initialMessageEn: Hi, what can I get for you guys today? Are you ready to order?
scenarios.initialMessageVi: Chào mừng quý khách! Tôi có thể giúp gì cho bạn hôm nay?

vocabulary.exampleEn: Do you have a reservation with us?
vocabulary.exampleVi: Quý khách có đặt bàn trước với chúng tôi không?

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Hi, what can I get for you guys today? Are you ready to order?

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Excuse me, can we order now? But first, what do you recommend? What's your most popular dish here?

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Our ribeye steak and seafood pasta are definitely our top best-sellers.

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: What's the dish of the day? What would you personally choose?

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Today's special is grilled salmon served with asparagus. Personally, that's my absolute favorite.

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: That sounds fantastic! Is that dish gluten-free?

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Yes, that dish is completely gluten-free.

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Awesome. We'll take a minute to decide our main courses.

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Take your time, we're in no rush at all.

scenarios.titleVi: Gọi món chi tiết & Tùy chỉnh
scenarios.situation: Tình huống tại nhà hàng: Gọi món chi tiết & Tùy chỉnh
scenarios.initialMessageEn: Welcome back! Are you ready to place your order?
scenarios.initialMessageVi: Chào mừng quý khách! Tôi có thể giúp gì cho bạn hôm nay?

vocabulary.exampleEn: Do you have a reservation with us?
vocabulary.exampleVi: Quý khách có đặt bàn trước với chúng tôi không?

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Welcome back! Are you ready to place your order?

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Yes, we're ready. For the appetizers, let me get the chicken wings as well as the French fries, please.

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Fantastic choice. And what would you like for the main course?

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Let me get the ribeye steak with a side of mashed potatoes, please.

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Great choice! And how would you like your steak cooked?

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Let me get that medium rare, please.

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Understood: ribeye steak, medium rare with mashed potatoes. And for your guest?

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: I'd like the grilled chicken pasta, but could you make it less spicy, please? And no onions, please.

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Noted: grilled chicken pasta, less spicy, no onions. Would you like the dressing on the side?

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Yes, extra cheese, and dressing on the side, please.

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Ok. And what would you like to drink?

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Can I just get a glass of red wine, and a bottle of mineral water, please?

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Sure, no problem! I'll be right back with your drinks and appetizers.

Let me get the ribeye steak with a side of mashed potatoes, please.
Let me get that medium rare, please.

scenarios.titleVi: Trong bữa ăn & Xử lý sự cố
scenarios.situation: Tình huống tại nhà hàng: Trong bữa ăn & Xử lý sự cố
scenarios.initialMessageEn: Right away, here is a fresh set of cutlery and napkins for you.
scenarios.initialMessageVi: Chào mừng quý khách! Tôi có thể giúp gì cho bạn hôm nay?

vocabulary.exampleEn: Do you have a reservation with us?
vocabulary.exampleVi: Quý khách có đặt bàn trước với chúng tôi không?

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Excuse me, could we get some cutlery? And can I get another napkin, please?

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Right away, here is a fresh set of cutlery and napkins for you.

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Could we also have some more water and extra bread, please?

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Certainly, I'll have the kitchen prepare another basket of warm bread for you.

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Excuse me, I think this is not what I ordered. There seems to be a mistake with my order, and the food is cold.

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: I am so sorry about that! Let me check the ticket for you immediately. Apologies for the inconvenience.

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Could you please replace this with a warm, fresh one?

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Certainly! We will have the kitchen prepare a fresh replacement right away. We'll get it out as soon as possible.

scenarios.titleVi: Đánh giá món ăn & Món tráng miệng
scenarios.situation: Tình huống tại nhà hàng: Đánh giá món ăn & Món tráng miệng
scenarios.initialMessageEn: Hi, how was everything? How is everything tasting so far?
scenarios.initialMessageVi: Chào mừng quý khách! Tôi có thể giúp gì cho bạn hôm nay?

vocabulary.exampleEn: Do you have a reservation with us?

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Hi, how was everything? How is everything tasting so far?

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: The food was excellent! The steak was truly delicious and cooked to perfection. Thank you very much.

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: I'm so glad to hear that! Fantastic. Would you like to order any dessert?

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: No, I'm stuffed, thank you!

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Would you like any coffee or tea, or would you like to pick a light dessert?

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Actually, just surprise me with your best dessert to share.

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: You got it! I'll bring out our house specialty dessert right away.

scenarios.initialMessageEn: Is there anything else I can help you guys with?

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Is there anything else I can help you guys with?

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: No, we're all good, thank you. Can I just get the bill and a to-go box for these leftovers?

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Of course. I'll just leave the bill right here, and I'll be right back with that to-go box.

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Could you split the bill between us?

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Sure, would you like to split it evenly down the middle?

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Yes, please. Can I pay by card?

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Yes, we accept all major cards. You can tap or insert right here.

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Is service included in the total?

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Yes, a service charge is already included in the total.

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Great. Keep the change as an extra tip for your wonderful service today!

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: That's very kind of you, thank you so much! Thank you for dining with us today!

sampleDialogue.speaker: user
sampleDialogue.textEn: Thank you, the meal was wonderful! Have a great day!

sampleDialogue.speaker: ai
sampleDialogue.textEn: Thank you! Have a wonderful day ahead, hope to see you again soon!
